outcomes_at_freeze: No weighted selection outcomes have been calculated or inspected.
arithmetic: Float64 count_i * score_i, accumulated in original fold order 1..5, divided by total count. Uniform counts must equal np.mean(original five scores) exactly. Peer Jaccard is accumulated in stable_mask_hash then numeric run_id order, matching the archived NumPy <=4-peer mean. No score rounding or tolerant comparator.
source_array_choice: Use authoritative merged candidate-audit arrays. Raw AMP-AD fold CSV differs in the last bit for 17/90 candidates (maximum1.1102230246251565e-16); this is recorded, not silently substituted.

fold_bootstrap.probability: multiplicity/3125; NOT equal weights for126 vectors

pairing: Each bank uses identical fold counts for all five candidates and all four policies.
aggregation: Equal bank weights; primary proposed-minus-highest comparison; all54, TCGA30, AMP-AD24, nonRush48, AMP-AD-nonRush18, Rush6 and cohort-by-branch; initial-equal/different policy strata secondary.
validation: independent NumPy scores and four-policy choices at eight specified vectors
enumerate all3125 ordered bootstrap samples to check multiplicities

fold_provenance.TCGA: 150 five-value arrays; locking_cv_seed342 shared within all30 banks; source scorer constructs one deterministic StratifiedKFold on the same X/y. Outer-fold ID is not inner-fold ID.
fold_provenance.AMPAD_nonrush: Explicit center/branch/cap/run_id/fold/locking_score CSV,450 rows, folds1..5 for all90 candidates; source scorer shares StratifiedKFold(seed42).
fold_provenance.Rush: Recovered run-level records all30 share development fold identity hash d80910ff2bc4a718f5b1baa0927a0691f6eca5ea01a9646d4e5e3e2ca1b3c077. run_id_one_based and seeds42..46 match fixed_development_CV_fold_scores arrays. No participant fold indices accessed; secondary48-bank result excludes these six banks because explicit fold-index provenance is weaker.

limits: Descriptive fold-score sensitivity distribution, NOT generalization confidence intervals or posterior probabilities.
Folds share training data; cases and banks are dependent.
Fixed masks cannot assess fresh candidate generation/new seed bank stability.
Development-score gaps are not true predictive regret.
No new model fits, GA, participant data, held-out outcomes, figures or manuscript edits.
